displayIdentity.body: Paul and Barnabas separate over John Mark. After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.” He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.
